patterns.note: Content is organized in a flexible grid, adapting from single-column for hero/featured articles to multi-column (two or three) for article listings, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.
Prominent use of a bold, uppercase sans-serif font for all section titles (e.g., 'EXPLAINERS', 'POLITICS'), creating strong visual breaks and a consistent editorial tone.
A high-contrast color scheme dominated by a vibrant yellow, black, and white, with yellow consistently used for the full-width header and footer backgrounds, acting as a strong brand identifier.

The header transforms upon scroll: the initial tall yellow bar with a large 'Vox' logo and centered navigation shrinks into a compact sticky bar at the top, with a smaller logo and navigation elements repositioned to the right, along with new 'SIGN IN' and 'BECOME A MEMBER' links.
A distinctive 'Start Here' section uses a numbered list format to highlight key introductory articles, guiding users through essential content in a structured manner.

technique_notes: The header implements a scroll-triggered transformation: initially a tall, full-width yellow bar with a large, centered logo and main navigation below it, it transitions into a compact, sticky yellow bar at the top of the viewport. During this transition, the logo shrinks and moves to the top-left, while the main navigation items reposition to its right, and additional utility links appear on the far right.
The hero section features an auto-playing video background that provides dynamic visual interest, with article headlines and text overlaid for readability.

Content sections are clearly delineated by bold, uppercase headings and utilize a flexible grid system that adapts to display articles in one, two, or three columns, often accompanied by prominent images or video thumbnails.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2.5x body) with smaller, uppercase labels for categories and very readable body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with clear vertical rhythm between sections and articles, and generous padding in the header and footer.

standout: The bold and consistent use of a vibrant, almost neon yellow as a primary brand color, especially in the full-width header and footer, immediately distinguishes the site. This, combined with the large, custom 'Vox' wordmark and the transforming sticky header, creates a strong, recognizable brand presence that feels both modern and authoritative.
